# interactive-dot-grid

Browser build of [interactive-dot-grid](https://github.com/sathishk-dev/interactive-dot-grid)
0.1.2 by sathishk-dev, MIT licensed (see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)).

This copy differs from the version published on npm (for example the default
`maxAlpha` and the canvas setup), so it is kept here instead of installed as a
dependency. It exposes the global `InteractiveDotGrid` used by
[`src/scripts/shared/dot-background.js`](../../scripts/shared/dot-background.js).
